blog_title: DTF Print on Polyester vs Cotton — Why ₹30K Order Bubbled in Rain (Monsoon Printing Guide)
caption:
Buyer ordered 300 polos in 10 colors. We had to say no. 😬

Here's why: Round necks? 15 colors, easy. Polos need matching collar rib + button placket + cuff. Each color = 3-4 dyed components to match perfectly. 10 colors = 60+ batches. Shade mismatch kills the whole order.

Manufacturers stick to 6-8 colors. New color needs 500-piece minimum.

Save this if you're sourcing polos for your next bulk order 👇
